query: I am turning 55 later this year. How can I top up if my Retirement Account has not been created yet?
reference_answer: If your Retirement Account has not been created yet, you can top up to your Special Account (SA). Cash top-ups to your SA will be considered for matching grants under the Matched Retirement Savings Scheme.
